suggestion.action: With power disconnected, visually inspect the mains fuse and check continuity across it.
suggestion.expected_result: A healthy fuse shows near 0 Ω continuity; an open fuse indicates it has blown.
suggestion.rationale: Vision suggests a fuse-like region on the PSU, intake reports no power, and retrieved notes prioritize fuse checks first.
safety_notes: Mains voltage hazard: unplug the unit and ensure capacitors are discharged before probing. You remain fully responsible.
